clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Group comparisons on mean deviation maps using PALM with permutation-based multiple-comparison correction; correlations between total extreme deviation counts and PANSS scores (e.g., pooled BP+SZ r ≈ 0.241, p < .001).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Robust group-level differences coexist with marked individual-level heterogeneity; only a small proportion of patients show extreme deviations in the same regions, replicating prior findings across two independent samples.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Across both replications, SZ showed more widespread mean negative deviations than HC and BP (frontal/temporal/cerebellar), corrected via PALM. Individual-level overlap of extreme deviations was low, with peak voxel overlaps typically <~10% per group; extreme negative deviations were on average ~3.9–5.0× more prevalent in SZ than HC across samples. The cerebellar BP vs HC effect from the discovery sample was not replicated. Associations showed that higher total extreme negative deviations related to higher PANSS scores when pooling SZ+BP (e.g., r ≈ 0.241, p < .001). Threshold sensitivity analyses (|Z|>2.6 vs 1.96) yielded comparable qualitative patterns.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Analytical pipeline adheres to prior study and is publicly available per authors; forward-model visualizations used to summarize age/sex effects; PALM used for permutation-based correction on group contrasts; supplementary shows robustness to threshold choice.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Single-site per sample without explicit scanner/site harmonization; caution about multi-scanner confounds. Adult-predominant samples despite earlier typical onset of SZ. Structural MRI only; other modalities may capture common pathophysiology more effectively.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: MRI acquisition details: Discovery 1.5T Siemens Sonata (MPRAGE); Rep1 3T GE 750 Discovery (BRAVO); Rep2 3T GE Signa HDxT. Healthy/control and patient Ns, ages, and male percentages listed in Table 1. Authors note ongoing work on multi-site normative modeling (Kia et al., 2020). DOI: 10.1002/hbm.25386.
